questions.body: SAMPLE: What does a red octagonal sign usually mean?
questions.explanation: SAMPLE: A red octagon is the usual stop sign.

questions.body: SAMPLE: Which shapes are commonly used for warning signs?
questions.explanation: SAMPLE: Warning signs are often triangles or diamonds.

questions.body: SAMPLE: A blue circular sign usually gives what kind of instruction?
questions.explanation: SAMPLE: Blue circles usually give mandatory instructions.

questions.body: SAMPLE: A school bus with flashing red lights has stopped ahead. What do you do?
questions.explanation: SAMPLE: Stop and wait until the lights stop flashing.

questions.body: SAMPLE: What should you do at a pedestrian crossing when someone is waiting to cross?
questions.explanation: SAMPLE: Pedestrians waiting at a crossing have priority.

questions.body: SAMPLE: When must you use dipped headlights?
questions.explanation: SAMPLE: Use dipped headlights at night and in poor visibility.
